task.title: Compare release approaches
task.description: Compare sequencing, risks, and validation. Choose a complete plan or keep individual decisions.
task.provenance: Illustrative fixture authored to demonstrate the reusable dashboard. These are not independent persona reviews or recommendations for an actual release.
task.baseline: A hypothetical team is preparing a release. No production system is involved.

reviewers.name: Reliability lens
reviewers.subtitle: Prioritizes containment and observable release gates.
reviewers.philosophy: Prioritizes containment and observable release gates.
reviewers.tradeoff: Requires choosing between rollout stages and implementation scope.

sections.heading: Release sequence
sections.markdown:
## Release sequence

Start with an internal canary, inspect results, then expand gradually.

sections.heading: Risks and assumptions
sections.markdown:
## Risks and assumptions

A canary must exercise representative requests. Rare paths may remain untested.

sections.heading: Validation and rollback
sections.markdown:
## Validation and rollback

Define rollback triggers before rollout. Check errors and latency at each stage.

reviewers.name: Delivery lens
reviewers.subtitle: Prioritizes a small release with an easy recovery path.
reviewers.philosophy: Prioritizes a small release with an easy recovery path.
reviewers.tradeoff: Requires choosing between rollout stages and implementation scope.

sections.heading: Release sequence
sections.markdown:
## Release sequence

Ship the smallest reversible change first. Separate unrelated migrations from the release.

sections.heading: Risks and assumptions
sections.markdown:
## Risks and assumptions

A smaller release may delay dependent features. Confirm the change can be reverted independently.

sections.heading: Validation and rollback
sections.markdown:
## Validation and rollback

Run a focused smoke check, inspect the first results, and revert if the agreed checks fail.
